description: It searches the media library of the site for images and returns id, address, title and the alt text. Take it when a host wants a picture somewhere and names it by what it shows instead of by its address. "Use the picture of the whiteboard." You can search by what the image shows or what it is called, and leave the search out to see the recent images. It only reads and changes nothing. Read-only, it changes nothing. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers. Words hosts use: media library, image search, alt text, picture

limit.description: How many images to return, 1-50. Default 10.

search.description: What the image shows or what it is called. Leave it out to list recent images.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

name: wi_find_media
title: Find an image in the media library
